answer: The prism of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The walnut holds work receipts rather than names, so the falcon of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on invitation quota tree, taxed when attestations come from one subnet. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
